# Loadout — full content

## AI Code Editors & IDEs
- **Cursor** (freemium) — AI code editor and coding agent platform; hand off tasks to agents or code alongside them. Best for: Day-to-day coding with an agent inside your editor. https://cursor.com (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf)** (freemium) — Cognition's IDE (Windsurf renamed June 2026) with an Agent Command Center for managing local and cloud agents. Best for: Managing multiple agents from a full IDE. https://devin.ai/desktop (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **GitHub Copilot** (freemium) — AI pair programmer in VS Code, JetBrains and GitHub, with chat and agent mode. Best for: Teams already living on GitHub. https://github.com/features/copilot (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Zed** (freemium) — Fast, Rust-built collaborative code editor with built-in AI assistance. Best for: Speed-focused devs who want AI without bloat. https://zed.dev (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **JetBrains Air** (freemium) — JetBrains' agentic development environment for running Claude Agent, Codex, Junie, Copilot and ACP agents, in IDEs, browser or CLI. Best for: JetBrains users orchestrating coding agents. https://www.jetbrains.com/air/ (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Kiro** (freemium) — AWS's agentic IDE built around spec-driven development. Best for: Turning a spec into structured code. https://kiro.dev (verified: 2026-10-15)

## App Builders (Prompt-to-App)
- **Lovable** (freemium) — Build full-stack web apps by chatting, with Supabase integration. Best for: Non-coders shipping a real web app. https://lovable.dev (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Bolt.new** (freemium) — StackBlitz's in-browser prompt-to-app builder that runs code in WebContainers. Best for: Fast prototypes in the browser. https://bolt.new (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **v0** (freemium) — Vercel's generative UI and app builder producing React/Next.js code. Best for: Next.js UIs you can deploy to Vercel. https://v0.app (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Replit** (freemium) — Cloud IDE with Replit Agent that builds and deploys apps from prompts. Best for: Build-and-host in one place. https://replit.com (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Base44** (freemium) — No-code AI app builder that generates apps with built-in backend. Best for: Internal tools and simple apps, no setup. https://base44.com (verified: 2026-10-15)

## Coding Agents
- **Claude Code** (paid) — Anthropic's agentic coding tool for the terminal and IDEs. Best for: Large, multi-step coding tasks from the terminal. https://www.anthropic.com/claude-code (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **OpenAI Codex** (paid) — OpenAI's coding agent across ChatGPT, CLI, IDE extension and cloud; included in ChatGPT plans. Best for: Delegating tasks and automated PR review. https://openai.com/codex/ (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **OpenCode** (free) — Open-source, model-agnostic coding agent with terminal, desktop and web apps. Best for: Open-source agent with any model. https://opencode.ai (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Cline** (free) — Open-source autonomous coding agent for VS Code; bring your own model. Best for: Transparent agent inside VS Code. https://cline.bot (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Aider** (free) — Open-source AI pair programming in your terminal with git integration. Best for: Git-native terminal pair programming. https://aider.chat (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Devin** (freemium) — Cognition's autonomous coding agent running parallel cloud agents. Best for: Hands-off async engineering tasks. https://devin.ai (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Jules** (freemium) — Google's asynchronous coding agent that works on your GitHub repos. Best for: Background fixes on GitHub repos. https://jules.google (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Amp** (freemium) — Sourcegraph's agentic coding tool for terminal and editors. Best for: Frontier-model agent work. https://ampcode.com (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Reason** (freemium) — Cost-efficient coding agent that writes code, runs tests and opens PRs from Mac, terminal, web or Slack. Best for: Cost-efficient autonomous coding and PRs. https://reasonmachines.com (verified: 2026-10-15)

## Agent Frameworks
- **LangGraph** (free) — Framework from LangChain for building stateful, multi-step agent graphs. Best for: Controllable production agents. https://www.langchain.com/langgraph (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **CrewAI** (freemium) — Open-source multi-agent framework plus a paid hosted platform. Best for: Multi-agent teams quickly. https://www.crewai.com (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **OpenAI Agents SDK** (free) — Lightweight SDK for building agents with tools, handoffs and guardrails. Best for: Agents on OpenAI models. https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-python/ (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Mastra** (free) — TypeScript framework for AI agents, workflows and RAG. Best for: JS/TS developers building agents. https://mastra.ai (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Vercel AI SDK** (free) — TypeScript toolkit for building AI apps and agents across model providers. Best for: AI features in Next.js/React apps. https://ai-sdk.dev (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Agent-Native** (free) — Builder.io's open-source TypeScript framework for agentic apps where agent and UI share actions, data and state. Best for: Building agentic apps with a real UI. https://www.agent-native.com (verified: 2026-10-15)

## Deploy, Hosting & Backend
- **Vercel** (freemium) — Frontend cloud for deploying Next.js and other web apps. Best for: Deploying frontends in one click. https://vercel.com (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Netlify** (freemium) — Platform for deploying and hosting web apps and sites. Best for: Static and Jamstack sites. https://www.netlify.com (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Supabase** (freemium) — Open-source Postgres backend with auth, storage and edge functions. Best for: Backend for vibe-coded apps. https://supabase.com (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Convex** (freemium) — Reactive backend platform with database and server functions in TypeScript; open source. Best for: Realtime apps in TypeScript. https://www.convex.dev (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Cloudflare Workers** (freemium) — Serverless platform for running code at the edge, including agents. Best for: Cheap global serverless + agents. https://workers.cloudflare.com (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Railway** (freemium) — Deploy apps, databases and services from a repo with minimal config. Best for: Hosting backends without DevOps. https://railway.com (verified: 2026-10-15)

## Design-to-Code
- **Figma Make** (freemium) — Figma's prompt-to-app tool that turns designs and prompts into working prototypes. Best for: Designers turning ideas into prototypes. https://www.figma.com/make/ (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Builder.io** (freemium) — Visual development platform that converts Figma designs to code. Best for: Figma-to-production code. https://www.builder.io (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Locofy** (freemium) — Converts Figma/Penpot designs into frontend code. Best for: Design handoff to React/HTML. https://www.locofy.ai (verified: no)

## AI APIs & Models
- **Anthropic API (Claude)** (paid) — API access to Claude models, strong at coding and agentic work. Best for: Powering coding agents. https://www.anthropic.com/api (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **OpenAI API** (paid) — API for GPT models, embeddings, images and realtime voice. Best for: General-purpose AI features. https://platform.openai.com (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Google Gemini API** (freemium) — Gemini models via Google AI Studio with long context and a free tier. Best for: Long context and generous free tier. https://ai.google.dev (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **OpenRouter** (freemium) — Single API to access hundreds of models from many providers. Best for: Swapping models behind one key. https://openrouter.ai (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Groq** (freemium) — Fast inference cloud for open models, built on its LPU hardware. Best for: Low-latency responses. https://groq.com (verified: no)

## Sports AI Tools
- **BALLDONTLIE** (freemium) — Sports data API for 20+ leagues (NBA, NFL, MLB, NHL, soccer, esports and more) with odds, an OpenAPI spec built for AI assistants, and a free tier. Best for: Stats and odds data for sports shows and apps. https://www.balldontlie.io (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **API-Sports** (freemium) — REST sports data APIs covering 2,000+ competitions with live scores, odds and free widgets; free plan of 100 requests/day per API, paid from $10/month. Best for: Cheap live scores and stats across many sports. https://api-sports.io (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **StoryStats** (freemium) — Automated sports writer that turns game data into ready-to-publish stories for NBA, WNBA, MLB, NHL, NFL and soccer; free start, $30/month per sport. Best for: Auto-written game previews and recaps. https://www.storystats.ai (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Castmagic** (paid) — AI that turns podcast audio and video into show notes, clips, posts and other content. Best for: Repurposing each episode into posts and show notes. https://www.castmagic.io (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **OpusClip** (freemium) — AI video clipping tool that turns long videos into short clips with captions, reframing and a social scheduler. Best for: Turning episodes into shorts. https://www.opus.pro (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Descript** (freemium) — Text-based video and audio editor with multitrack podcast editing, remote recording, transcription and captions. Best for: Editing and recording podcast episodes. https://www.descript.com (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **Magnifi** (paid) — AI video tagging and automated sports highlights platform, now part of Sportz Interactive; demo-based sales. Best for: Media teams automating highlight production. https://magnifi.ai (verified: 2026-10-15)
- **WSC Sports** (paid) — AI platform for creating, managing and distributing sports highlights, used by 650 teams, leagues and broadcasters; demo-based sales. Best for: Leagues and broadcasters scaling highlights. https://www.wsc-sports.com (verified: 2026-10-15)

## Which tool should I use
- I can't code but want to ship a web app: Lovable > Bolt.new > Replit
- I code daily and want an AI editor: Cursor > Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf) > GitHub Copilot
- I want an agent to handle big tasks in my repo: Claude Code > OpenAI Codex > OpenCode
- I want a free/open-source coding agent: OpenCode > Cline > Aider
- I need a backend + database fast: Supabase > Convex > Railway
- I want to deploy my app: Vercel > Netlify > Cloudflare Workers
- I'm building my own AI agent: Agent-Native > Vercel AI SDK > Mastra
- I want to turn a design into code: Figma Make > Builder.io > Locofy
- Which model API should power my app?: Anthropic API (Claude) > OpenAI API > Google Gemini API
- I run a sports podcast or channel: Descript > OpusClip > Castmagic > BALLDONTLIE

## Comparisons
- **Cursor vs Devin Desktop (2026)** — Cursor (freemium) — AI code editor and coding agent platform; hand off tasks to agents or code alongside them. Best for: Day-to-day coding with an agent inside your editor. Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf) (freemium) — Cognition's IDE (Windsurf renamed June 2026) with an Agent Command Center for managing local and cloud agents. Best for: Managing multiple agents from a full IDE. Editorial comparison; rankings and picks are never sold. https://loadoutweekly.com/compare/cursor-vs-devin-desktop.html

## New releases
- 2026-10-13 **OpenCode 2.0** — Open-source, model-agnostic coding agent with native TUI and multi-session support. #2 on Product Hunt's Oct 13 daily leaderboard (313 upvotes when checked). Source: https://www.producthunt.com/leaderboard/daily/2026/10/13
- 2026-10-14 **Tiden** — Verifies coding agents built what you asked for by checking changes against requirements and tests. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot. Source: https://www.producthunt.com/leaderboard/daily/2026/10/14
- 2026-10-14 **Reason** — Cost-efficient coding agent that writes code, runs tests and opens PRs, from Mac app, terminal, web or Slack. Source: https://www.producthunt.com/leaderboard/daily/2026/10/14
- 2026-10-14 **Exodus for Google Cloud Run** — Free tool with an open-source CLI: your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) audits your app, compares current cost vs Cloud Run, and migrates it task by task using 50+ playbooks. #8 on launch day. Source: https://www.producthunt.com/products/exodus-by-elim-io
- 2026-10-14 **Agent-Native** — Builder.io open-source TypeScript framework for agentic apps: agent and UI share the same actions, data and state, with MCP and A2A built in. Beta launched Oct 14. Source: https://www.builder.io/blog/introducing-agent-native
- 2026-10-14 **Epherem** — Free security scanner for AI-built apps (Lovable, Bolt, v0, Cursor, Claude Code). Finds auth, DB, secret and package issues, with fix prompts for your coding agent. Source: https://www.producthunt.com/leaderboard/daily/2026/10/14
- 2026-10-14 **VS Code 1.142** — Stable release adds agent canvases (preview), move chats across folders/worktrees, Copilot harness as default for new sessions, and enterprise agent permission controls. Source: https://code.visualstudio.com/updates/v1_142
- 2026-10-16 **Navige** — Sits between your AI agents and the models/tools they pay for: caching, context trimming, loop guards and smart routing to cut agent costs. Free Watchtower plan; paid plans charge a share of savings. Source: https://www.producthunt.com/products/navige
- 2026-10-16 **withHuman** — Open-source approval layer for AI agents: intercepts consequential tool calls and routes them through rules or a human reviewer. Hooks for coding agents and an MCP gateway. Open source free; cloud Scale plan $20/user/mo. Source: https://withhuman.ai
- 2026-10-16 **Polylane** — Production issue agent: maps your clouds, code and telemetry, catches pull requests that would break production, finds root causes and writes fixes. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex. Free plan; paid from $80/mo. Source: https://polylane.com/pricing
- 2026-10-16 **AI Sandboxes by Buddy** — Real Linux VMs for running AI-generated code and the apps it becomes, controlled via CLI, SDK, YAML or MCP, with snapshots and public endpoints. Source: https://www.producthunt.com/products/buddy/launches/ai-sandboxes-by-buddy
- 2026-10-15 **Muse Spark Open** — Meta's open-weight coding and agent model: 816B total / 42B active MoE, 1M-token context, multimodal input. Weights on Hugging Face under the Muse Model License; API via OpenRouter, Groq, Together, Fireworks and others; runs on two M5 Ultra Mac Studios with MLX. Source: https://research.meta.ai/blog/muse-spark-open
- 2026-10-15 **Figma code layers, Specs and agent GA** — Figma's Build by Design launch: code-backed prototypes on the canvas (code layers, open beta on all plans), Markdown Specs for shared context (open beta, paid plans), the Figma agent now generally available, and Figma MCP updates for coding agents. Source: https://www.figma.com/blog/build-by-design/
- 2026-10-15 **Kerno 1.0** — AI backend QA engineer that maps your codebase and tests full user flows, security, background jobs, queues, MCP servers and AWS serverless, catching bugs inside your agent's session and again on every PR in CI. Free tier to start. Source: https://www.producthunt.com/leaderboard/daily/2026/10/15
- 2026-10-15 **GitHub agentic autofix (GA)** — Assign a code scanning alert to Copilot and it explores the codebase, proposes a fix, reruns CodeQL to confirm it closes the alert, then opens a draft PR. For GitHub Code Security / Advanced Security on Enterprise Cloud. Source: https://github.blog/changelog/2026-10-15-agentic-autofix-for-code-scanning-alerts-general-availability
